faqs.question: How do I know this keyboard fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits the HP ProBook 440 G9, 445 G9, 440 G10, 445 G10, 640 G8, 645 G8 and EliteBook 640 G9, 640 G10, which share the same chassis. If you're unsure of your exact model, send us a photo of the sticker under your laptop on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.

faqs.question: Is it backlit?
faqs.answer: Yes, this version includes the backlight cable, matching the original.

faqs.question: Do you also stock a non-backlit version?
faqs.answer: Not currently for this series — please check back or ask us on WhatsApp.
